verdict.rationale: Daily notes is a first-party core plugin that opens today's dated note, or creates it if it doesn't exist (obsidian-docs-4). Templates is a separate core plugin for inserting predefined snippets (obsidian-docs-5). Community users confirm daily notes as a working journaling pattern (obsidian-comm-4). Missing for 10: explicit evidence that the daily note is auto-filled from a chosen template, evidence that it opens automatically on startup as the default landing note, and independent hands-on corroboration of the template-plus-daily-note workflow.
